title: Watch: Traitor or faithful? Celebrities reveal their allegiances
originalTitle: Watch: Traitor or faithful? Celebrities reveal their allegiances
content:
Warning: Video contains spoilers.

The second series of BBC One's The Celebrity Traitors reached its climax on Friday, with the 21 original contestants having been reduced to seven before the final.

We knew all along who the traitors were, but here's the moment the contestants revealed their allegiances to their fellow celebrities.
